A2A Task ends in terminal state `failed` (with partial artifact status='PENDING_REVIEW', covered=false, payable_amount=0) because an upstream worker HTTP 500 is a system/infrastructure fault, NOT missing human input. By contrast, `input-required` is reserved for cases like CLM-2026-00010 (empty adjuster_notes -> cause='unknown') where the system is healthy and must pause awaiting the human adjuster's confirmation of the cause of loss.

a2a_lifecycle.why_failed_not_input_required: The injected HTTP 500 on CLM-2026-00002 should end in `failed` (while emitting a safe degraded artifact `PENDING_REVIEW`, `covered=false`, `payable_amount=0`), NOT `input-required`, because the adjuster notes were already complete (`cause='flood'`) and the human adjuster cannot fix a crashed exclusions worker by typing confirmation. `input-required` belongs to CLM-2026-00010 (empty adjuster notes), where the task pauses awaiting the adjuster's incident description to resume.
what_a2a_buys_over_rest_two_lines: 1. Stateful task lifecycle & resumability: Unlike a stateless REST call that either blocks or drops context on a timeout/pause, A2A gives every delegated task a durable task_id with explicit states (`submitted`, `working`, `input-required`, `completed`, `failed`), allowing a claim missing adjuster confirmation to pause at `input-required` and resume on the same task thread without re-running prior workers.

2. Standardized capability discovery & negotiated modalities: Via the published `AgentCard` (skills, input/output MIME modes, and OAuth/Bearer auth schemes), the orchestrator discovers what peer agents can do, negotiates structured JSON vs. streaming updates, and collects partial artifacts on failure without hard-coding bespoke REST endpoints per worker.

agent_card.name: claims-squad-orchestrator
agent_card.description: Multi-agent insurance claims triage orchestrator. Decomposes a claim question, delegates to an Adjuster-Note Summary Worker and a Coverage & Exclusions Worker, and synthesises a grounded coverage/payout verdict.

authentication.credentials: OAuth2 Client Credentials JWT (audience='a2a://claims-squad-orchestrator') with required scopes: ['claims:read', 'policy:exclusions:evaluate', 'claims:triage:write'].

skills.name: End-to-End Claim Triage & Payout Synthesis
skills.description: Accepts a claim_id, coordinates adjuster-note cause extraction and policy exclusion verification, computes the net payout after deductible and sub-limits, and returns the canonical 8-field claim decision JSON.
examples: Triage claim CLM-2026-00002 and report status, coverage, exclusion, and payable amount.

skills.name: Adjuster-Note Cause Extraction (Delegated Worker Skill)
skills.description: Reads raw adjuster notes for a claim_id and extracts the structured cause of loss (flood, theft, accidental_damage, fire, wear_and_tear, collision, general, unknown) and a 1-sentence factual summary.

skills.name: Policy Coverage & Exclusions Check (Delegated Worker Skill)
skills.description: Evaluates policy active status, per-cause exclusions, deductible (excess), and sub-limits for a scoped (policy_id, cause) pair.
